title: Baseline/org-state reconciliation
description: Root-pointer liveness snapshot; full inventory of current .github/workflows/*.yml plus git-history deleted/renamed workflows; aspose.org-workflows inventory (5 SEO templates + 7 site-build workflows); record known access gaps (missing read:org/admin:org, deprecated legacy billing endpoint, branch-protection blocked by plan tier).

title: Disabled-vs-running anomaly documentation
description: Write up the disabled_manually-vs-recent-successful-runs finding as a confirmed, user-attributed intentional emergency cost stopgap (confirmed 2026-09-16, this session) rather than an unexplained anomaly. Record at reports/plan_state/MT069-2026-09-16-GHA-MINUTES-REARCHITECTURE/inventory/disabled_vs_running_anomaly.md.

title: Structured inventory dataset + workflow-harden delegation
description: Build the structured per-workflow dataset (triggers, runners, jobs, permissions). Delegate the static-review/CI-weight half to /workflow-harden (S-115) and cite its reports/sprint/workflow-harden-{date}/ bundle rather than re-deriving the same 8-dimension probe results. Incorporate check_workflow_drift.py's IN_SYNC/DIVERGED/DEPLOYED_UNAPPROVED classification for the SEO templates.

title: Usage/billing collection and reconciliation
description: Reconstruct historical (pre-disable) per-workflow minutes from gh api runs/jobs data (ceil to billing minute, apply OS multiplier). Reconcile against the org Billing UI export the user will supply directly (no read:org/admin:org token grant needed).

title: Failure-signature analysis
description: Per-workflow failure rate/pattern from run history; distinguish product defects, workflow defects, dependency outages, flaky tests, etc.

title: Importance matrix
description: Criticality x frequency x consumer-impact-if-absent classification per workflow (P0_CRITICAL..RETIREMENT_CANDIDATE per the mission brief's taxonomy).

title: Destination-decision matrix + threat assessment
description: 13-value destination enum per workflow plus public/private data-boundary threat model (secrets exposure, credential scope). Includes the open question on the 4 auto-commit watcher bots (convert to PR-gated merge vs. stay closed-loop private).

title: Self-hosted architecture design (design-only)
description: WSL2-hosted runner + persistent listener with fresh Docker container per job, targeting this session's own Windows 11 Pro dev machine, reserved only for push-gated native workflows. Design only -- no runner registered/brought online in this mission. Genuine capability gap beyond S-115 -- covered by the gap-escalation report.

title: Public-execution boundary design
description: Reuse the proven SEO-template pattern (checkout via scoped token, push results back via PR, drift-checked). Explicit MT066 coordination note before any Phase-B canary PR targets Aspose/aspose.org-workflows.

title: Per-workflow dossiers
description: ~20 dossiers (one per current workflow, plus any found deleted/renamed) citing TC-03 through TC-09, each with a cited destination decision -- none left at INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE without a stated reason.

title: Independent review
description: Separate review pass validates dossiers, destination decisions, and threat assessment. No open CONFIRMED findings before Phase A is marked plan-ready.

title: Master report + plan-ready declaration
description: Synthesis report; run check_plan_taskcard_completeness.py against the governing plan and this mission's taskcards.jsonl; outstanding-human-decision ledger for anything still open before Phase B can be requested.
